claim_tested: Which VOPP1 tyrosine is required for WWOX binding
key_finding: Y165A reduces WWOX binding; Y119A and Y157A have no effect (UniProt-curated mutagenesis from this study)
confidence_limitations: Single study; reduction not abolition; only three of the candidate residues tested; no test of combined mutants

claim_tested: VOPP1 resides on the late endosome / lysosome membrane and sequesters WWOX there
key_finding: VOPP1 sequesters WWOX in lysosomes, blocks WWOX-p73alpha association and WWOX-dependent apoptosis
confidence_limitations: Basis of the existing IDA CC terms and of GO:0140311; overexpression component not fully separable

claim_tested: Does VOPP1 co-purify with more than one WW-domain protein
key_finding: VOPP1 AP-MS interactors include NEDD4 and WWOX together with EPHA2, TMEM259, ZER1, LRRC15, GBF1, MLST8
context: Human cell line, affinity purification MS (IntAct)
confidence_limitations: Co-purification only; no direct binding or motif mapping; NEDD4 interaction not independently validated

claim_tested: Can a C-terminal PY-motif array drive lysosomal targeting without cargo ubiquitination
key_finding: LAPTM5 PY motifs bind Nedd4 WW domains; PY-mutant or Nedd4-knockdown LAPTM5 is Golgi-retained; ubiquitination-impaired LAPTM5 still reaches the lysosome
confidence_limitations: Different protein; precedent only, no VOPP1 data

claim_tested: Generality of PY-motif-dependent Nedd4 binding in lysosomal membrane sorting
key_finding: LAPTM4a/4b Nedd4 interaction depends on LAPTM4 PY motifs and functions in membrane sorting

claim_tested: Is a YEQ-Phi tyrosine signal recognised by an AP complex mu subunit
key_finding: mu4 recognises the LAMP-2 tyrosine signal HTGYEQF
context: Yeast two-hybrid / in vitro, LAMP-2 peptide
confidence_limitations: LAMP-2 peptide, not VOPP1 YEQV; shows the class is recognised, not that VOPP1 is

claim_tested: Can tyrosine motifs in a PY-motif protein act as AP-2 binding sites
key_finding: Two of the tyrosine motifs function cooperatively as AP-2 binding sites
confidence_limitations: Different protein; raises the alternative that VOPP1 Y165 is an AP-2 rather than AP-3/AP-4 site

claim_tested: Is NF-kB activation a core VOPP1 function
key_finding: VOPP1 increases NFKB1 transcriptional activity when overexpressed
confidence_limitations: Overexpression-dependent, downstream of any direct activity; should not drive a core BP annotation

claim_tested: Topology and ordered/disordered partition of Q96AW1
key_finding: Signal peptide 1-22; disulfide-stapled lumenal domain 23-60 (mean pLDDT 82.0); TM helix 61-81 (pLDDT 83.6, KD max 2.24 at residue 72); cytoplasmic tail 82-172 with mean pLDDT 46.7-64.0 and 27.5% proline; 58.1% of residues pLDDT<70
confidence_limitations: Prediction; signal peptide and TM boundaries not experimentally mapped

claim_tested: Enumeration of endolysosomal sorting SLiMs in the cytoplasmic tail
key_finding: Three cytoplasmic PPxY (116-119, 154-157, 162-165); exactly one cytosolic YxxPhi (YEQV 165-168) which overlaps the PPPY; zero dileucine, DxxLL, NPxY, NPF, FYVE-core, SH3 class I/II motifs; only 2 cytoplasmic lysines (K170, K172)
context: Regex scan of Q96AW1 with topology assignment
confidence_limitations: Regex-based; UIM regex failed its LAPTM5 positive control so UIM absence is unresolved

claim_tested: Conservation ranking of the candidate determinants across vertebrates
key_finding: 27-ortholog alignment (mean identity 78.0%): PPPY 162-165 at 95.4% per-residue identity and PPxY-class in 27/27; YEQV 94.4%; PPAY 154-157 77.8% but PPxY-class 27/27; PPYY 116-119 only 64.8% with the first Pro lost in 22/27; RRRM 82-85 and C158 100%; C151 11.1%
context: 27 curated vertebrate orthologs, custom Needleman-Wunsch affine-gap alignment
confidence_limitations: Custom aligner, not a standard package (Biopython unavailable in executor)

claim_tested: Is the overlapping C-terminal PPxY+YxxPhi module statistically unusual and compartment-specific
key_finding: Module in the C-terminal 25 aa of only 33/20,414 reviewed human proteins (binomial one-sided p=7.3e-04 for C-terminal placement); that set is 6.10-fold enriched for endosome/lysosome/vesicle annotation (Fisher one-sided p=1.96e-05) and 3.95-fold for TM proteins (p=9.63e-05); members include LAPTM5, ARRDC3, ARRDC4, TMEM207, ATP9A
confidence_limitations: Annotation-based compartment labels; guilt by architecture, not a functional test

claim_tested: Does absence of annotated phosphosites near the PY motifs mean they are unphosphorylated
key_finding: MS coverage 43/172 residues (25%) with zero peptides over 150-172; residues 102-170 form a single 68-residue tryptic peptide with no internal K/R
confidence_limitations: Absence of evidence explained by detectability; does not establish phosphorylation

key_finding: 14 annotations, all CC or MF; zero BP terms. CC includes lysosome, lysosomal membrane, late endosome (membrane), endosome, cytoplasmic vesicle membrane. MF is protein binding, enzyme binding, and protein sequestering activity GO:0140311 (IDA, MGI, PMID:30285739)
confidence_limitations: Database state as retrieved; may lag recent literature
